x: I use the data to reply to you, give a quote, do the job and invoice it. The legal basis is that it is necessary to enter into and perform a contract with you (GDPR art. 6(1)(b)) and, for accounting, my legal obligation under the Danish Bookkeeping Act (art. 6(1)(c)).

p: Privacy policy
x: The form sends nothing to a server. It opens your own email app with the message filled in, and I only receive it as an ordinary email when you press send.

p: Privacy policy
h: The AI assistant and the microphone
x: The assistant answers from the texts on this site, inside your browser. Your questions are not stored and not sent to me. If you use the microphone, your browser turns speech into text: in Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge this uses the browser maker's speech service, so the audio is sent to their servers; in Safari it uses Apple. The microphone is only used when you tap it, and your browser asks for permission first.

p: Privacy policy
x: The videos play directly from this site. TikTok, Instagram and Facebook are ordinary links: only when you click do you open their site, and their own privacy rules apply.

p: Privacy policy
x: I do not sell or pass on your data. It is held by my email and web provider, who process it on my behalf, and invoices are part of my accounts.

p: Privacy policy
x: Enquiries that do not lead to a job are deleted when no longer needed. Invoices and accounting records are kept for five years after the end of the financial year, as the Danish Bookkeeping Act requires.

p: Privacy policy
x: You have the right to see the data I hold about you and to have it corrected or deleted. You can also ask for restriction, object, and receive your data (portability). Write to kontakt@everythingorganized.dk .
